goal: Keep canonical effect recognition separate from physical device controls, then admit the first explicit named-device adapter without touching source audio or hardware.

architecture.canonical: The chain analyzes an immutable mono 44.1 kHz five-second copy and returns only canonical families, order, and normalized controls.
architecture.device: An explicitly selected RAT adapter analyzes a separate immutable mono 48 kHz one-second copy and owns distortion, filter, and volume semantics.
architecture.routing: Only an accepted single Drive family may enter the RAT adapter; bypass, abstention, or a family mismatch delivers no physical settings.

development.source: ASRNN official evaluation split already used by ratknobs development; this replay is not new sealed evidence.

decision: Admit explicit RAT routing in optional chain 1.1.0 development packaging. Keep generic canonical controls and physical RAT settings distinct, and abstain when either recognition or device identifiability fails.
next: Train identity-to-device routing separately, then evaluate on a new untouched RAT session or device split before release or automatic device selection.
